method: Mixed-model CR2 with contrast-specific Satterthwaite and HTZ tests

data_generating_model.covariance_condition: interior random-intercept variance with cluster-level covariance and slope heterogeneity outside the fitted working target

failure_policy.optimizer_or_numerical_failure: retained as unavailable and never redrawn
failure_policy.test_denominator_failure: retained as unavailable and never redrawn
failure_policy.calibration_denominator: available paired tests only, with a separately gated unavailable rate

required_cases: synthetic higher-level independent clusters under ML and REML
sleepstudy correlated random intercept/slope under REML
required_intermediates: HTZ scale and denominator degrees of freedom

release_claim: Calibrated only for the declared Gaussian nested random-intercept regime with 12 independent clusters, unit weights, and the fitted marginal covariance as working target; independence is a user-supplied design assumption.
